_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Airwarm's current delivery partners.
Airwarm owns the customer journey, the assessment, the Desktop Review, the
calculations and the brand. Partners deliver parts of a project and are
expected to change. Airwarm must never become structurally dependent on one.
THIS SITE IS STATIC HTML WITH NO BUILD STEP, so nothing reads this file at
runtime. It is the register, not a template engine. What makes a partner
removable is that every mention in the HTML is tagged with an HTML comment:
<!-- PARTNER: solar-capture -->
so `grep -rn 'PARTNER:' --include=*.html .` returns the complete list in one
command. Keep that true. If you add a mention, tag it. If you remove a
partner, grep, delete every tagged block, and set status to 'former' here.
RULES
- Do not put a partner in the navigation, the homepage hero or the footer.
- Do not make routes, assessment logic, scoring or page structure depend
on a partner. Nothing in js/assessment.js references one, and nothing
should.
- Do not copy partner marketing claims. State the relationship only.
- Do not send anyone's details to a partner without the customer asking.
- Partner logos are not required and must not compete with Airwarm's.
REPLACEMENT TEST: a developer should be able to swap Solar Capture for
Airwarm's own solar work, or the Ample umbrella for Airwarm's own MCS
certification, by editing the tagged blocks and this file. Nothing else.

partners.name: Solar Capture Ltd
partners.role: Solar PV and battery storage installation
partners.description: West Yorkshire solar and battery installer. Where a customer wants new solar PV or battery storage, Solar Capture carries out that survey, design, quotation and installation as a separate part of the project.
partners.relationship: Delivery partner. Not part of AIRWARM LTD. Airwarm does not install solar itself.
notes: Official domain is solarcaptureltd.co.uk — NOT solarcapture.co.uk.
Referrals are customer-initiated only. No automatic data transfer exists,
and the privacy notice says so. If that ever changes, the privacy notice

partners.name: Ample
partners.role: MCS umbrella and compliance framework for launch
partners.description: Trading name of Fornax Energy Ltd. Airwarm plans to deliver qualifying installations through Ample's MCS umbrella rather than holding its own MCS certification at launch.
partners.relationship: Compliance framework provider. Airwarm carries out the survey, design and installation within that framework.
notes: NEVER state or imply Airwarm holds MCS certification itself. It is not independently
certified and must not be described as such.
Only claim responsibilities verified by the actual agreement. The exact
contractual division is NOT in this repository, so the site wording is
deliberately cautious and says responsibilities are confirmed before a
customer commits. Tighten it only against the signed agreement.
